notes.sheets: Each sheet is one API call drawing a grid of frames; the previous sheet is passed back as a reference so the next one continues it. 8 frames per 3072x1536 sheet gives 768 px cells.
notes.hold: Seconds per frame, one entry per frame across all sheets (the first and last frames are the crossfade with the still sticker).

animations.description: the frog does a backflip off its lily pad, lands, then flicks out its tongue to catch a passing fly.

frames: Sitting on the lily pad exactly as in the reference: same pose, same happy grin, looking slightly left.
Crouched low on the pad, body squashed down and wide, legs bent and coiled, eyes looking up, about to spring.
Launching straight up off the pad: body stretched tall and thin, arms flung up, legs fully extended, toes just leaving the pad.
In the air above the pad, leaning back, the start of a backflip: tilted backwards about 45 degrees, arms out, legs tucking in.
High above the pad at the top of the flip, fully upside down: belly to the sky, legs tucked, the happy face upside down.
Coming round: tilted forward past three quarters of the turn, head coming up, falling back toward the pad.
Upright again just above the pad, legs reaching down for it, arms out for balance, mouth open in a delighted grin.
Landed on the pad in a deep squash: body low and wide, arms out to the sides, feet spread, big proud smile, mouth closed. No fly and no tongue in this frame.
Sitting upright on the pad again, recovered, eyes turned up to the right where a small round fly with two tiny wings hovers in the top right.
Mouth opening wide, eyes locked on the fly, which has drifted a little closer.
A long pink tongue shooting out of the wide-open mouth up toward the fly, halfway there.
The tongue at full stretch, its rounded tip touching the fly.
The tongue snapping back toward the mouth with the fly stuck on its tip.
Mouth closed tight, cheeks puffed out full and round, eyes wide with surprise.
A satisfied gulp: eyes closed in a happy smile, cheeks back to normal, looking content.
Sitting on the lily pad exactly as in frame 1: same pose, same happy grin, looking slightly left, no fly anywhere.
